_comment: ORDER DAY: edit this file to match the Supreme Court's front-of-pack order, then run `python -I fssai.py --court`. The values below are TODAY'S (8 Oct 2026): ICMR-NIN DGI 2024 Table 15.1 limits as cited in FSSAI's 28 Aug 2026 affidavit, with FSSAI's 23 Sep single-phase trigger (any 1 of 3 high). Limits are per 100 g (solid) and per 100 ml (liquid). Salt is in mg; if the order gives sodium, write sodium_mg instead of salt_mg and it is converted (x 2.5). Rewrite label too, e.g. 'Limits and trigger in the Supreme Court's order of 21 Oct 2026; ...'. If the order adds a nutrient (saturated fat, energy) or uses total sugar or total fat, fssai.py needs a code change, not just this file.
label: ICMR-NIN DGI 2024 Table 15.1 thresholds as cited by FSSAI (affidavit 28 Aug 2026); warning when any 1 of added sugar, added fat, salt is high (FSSAI's 23 Sep 2026 single-phase plan); supplements left out by name
_trigger_examples: {"type": "any", "n": 2} = warning when 2 or more are high. {"type": "weighted", "weights": {"sugar": 2, "fat": 1, "salt": 1}, "cutoff": 2} = high sugar alone triggers, fat or salt only together.
